title: Perfect for what I wanted
text:
Perfect for what I wanted. These worked better than I imagined. I needed two stilocking holders that went with the rest of my decor. We wanted ones that lit up. We ordered these, and hoped for the best. They were perfect.

They look better than the pictures. They are battery operated. There is a switch on the side to turn them off and on.

Made well.
